author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The library filter option catalog is materialized from a second handwritten copy of the same category and language concepts used by text search.
findings.consequence: Future additions or label changes can make /bibliotek accept, order, or display filter values differently from /sök even though both ultimately use the same generated LibraryFilters category and language unions.
findings.evidence: createLibraryFilterOptions maps local collectionOptionGroups here, while app/pages/sök.vue defines matching categoryOptions at lines 104-143 and languageOptions at lines 88-102. The generated API type at app/lib/api/generated/lbapi.ts lines 1926-1934 also contains the same category and language value unions, so omissions in either handwritten UI catalog are not caught by the type system.
findings.recommendation: Move the shared category and language option data into one library module, export the grouped and flat projections needed by /bibliotek and /sök, and keep createLibraryFilterOptions as the per-page fresh Set/array factory over that shared source.
